presentation.name: Assess an inherited Tableau workbook before changing it
presentation.summary: Assesses a workbook nobody on the team built: what is in it, which dependencies make a change risky, and what the file cannot tell you.
benefits: Builds the field-to-worksheet index that answers what a change would propagate through
Separates unreferenced in the file from unused by anyone, instead of recommending deletions the file cannot justify
Finds the dependencies that break from outside, including custom SQL coupled to warehouse object names
Judges live against extract by what the dashboard is for, rather than calling one of them wrong
States what an audit of the file cannot conclude: correctness, runtime, layout and who uses it
